name: Floor Marking

length.label: Length (m)
length.desc: Extent along local X. Drag the dot on either end face to resize in the viewport.

width.label: Width (m)
width.desc: Extent along local Z. Drag the dot on either side face to resize in the viewport.

style.label: Style
style.desc: Which pattern is painted into the rectangle. Border draws an outline only and leaves the interior bare floor; every other style covers the whole footprint.

stripeSize.label: Stripe size (m)
stripeSize.desc: Width of one stripe or dash (the pattern repeats every two of them). Bands are phased from this part's own origin, so two markings laid end to end won't necessarily line up.

borderWidth.label: Border width (m)
borderWidth.desc: Width of the border band. Only the Border style draws one.

primaryColor.label: Primary color
primaryColor.desc: The base colour: the solid fill, the first hazard/stripe band, the dashed field, the border itself. Always painted, and always opaque - the bands are geometry, so partial alpha does nothing here.

secondaryColor.label: Secondary color
secondaryColor.desc: The alternating colour: the second hazard/stripe band and the dashes. Take its alpha all the way to zero to drop those bands entirely and leave bare floor between the primary ones; any other alpha paints opaque. Unused by Solid and Border.
